claim.quote: The mid-rapidity (dsigma_(pN)/dy at y=0) and total sigma_(pN) production cross sections of J/Psi mesons are measured in proton-nucleus interactions.

name: HERA-B J/psi production cross section in 920 GeV/c proton-nucleus interactions

summary.plain: HERA-B measured the production of J/psi mesons in 920 GeV proton collisions on carbon, titanium and tungsten targets, both at mid-rapidity and in total, using the data from its 2002-2003 run.
summary.technical: Mid-rapidity and total J/psi production cross sections in proton-nucleus interactions at 920 GeV/c with carbon, titanium and tungsten targets, J/psi reconstructed from lepton pairs: total cross section sigma_pN(J/psi) = 663 ± 74 ± 46 nb/nucleon.

title: Measurement of the J/Psi production cross section in 920 GeV/c fixed-target proton-nucleus interactions
why_it_matters: Provides J/psi production data at sqrt(s) = 41.6 GeV for tests of QCD production models and for nuclear-dependence studies.
